name: magentic-workspace
description: Ask questions, propose code changes, and review diffs in your personal workspace using local Ollama.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Agentick can show its panel. Repository reads, model requests, edits and tasks require workspace trust.

magentic.model.description: Model name on the local model service (see magentic.modelUrl).

magentic.modelUrl.description: Loopback address of the local model service speaking Ollama's chat API. Empty means http://127.0.0.1:11434. Point it at a local gateway to route through it.

magentic.guided.description: Explain actions and show beginner guidance.

magentic.workbenchUrl.description: Address of Agentick Developer on this machine, such as http://127.0.0.1:4173, to work with its approved assistants. Leave empty to use only the local model.

magentic.workbenchTokenFile.description: Path of the workbench's standalone client token (mcp-token). Leave empty for the default data directory.
